title: mspp_entitypermission
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): mspp_createdby, mspp_modifiedby, mspp_parententitypermission, mspp_websiteid.

mspp_append.description: Controls whether the user can attach another record to the specified record.

mspp_appendto.description: Controls whether the user can append the specified record to another record.

mspp_create.description: The Create privilege controls whether you can create a record.

mspp_createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

mspp_delete.description: Controls whether the user can delete a record.

mspp_entityname.description: The name of the custom entity.

mspp_modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was modified.

mspp_permissionfetchxml.description: Type the permission FetchXml with the filter.

mspp_read.description: Controls whether the user can read a record.

mspp_write.description: Controls whether the user can update a record.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Table Permission

_mspp_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_mspp_websiteid_value.description: Unique identifier for Website associated with Entity Permission
